```text
97	// CurrentLANScope checks whether a recorded scope still describes the same
98	// current interface, address set and explicitly selected ranges/ports. It reads
99	// local interface metadata only and does not probe or authenticate any endpoint.
100	func (s *Service) CurrentLANScope(scope string) (bool, error) {
101		parts := strings.Split(scope, ";")
102		if len(parts) != 4 || !strings.HasPrefix(parts[0], "interface=") || !strings.HasPrefix(parts[1], "onlink=") ||
103			!strings.HasPrefix(parts[2], "ranges=") || !strings.HasPrefix(parts[3], "ports=") {
104			return false, ErrInvalidScope
105		}
106		iface, index, ok := strings.Cut(strings.TrimPrefix(parts[0], "interface="), "#")
107		if !ok || iface == "" || index == "" {
108			return false, ErrInvalidScope
109		}
110		request := LANRequest{Interface: iface, Ranges: strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(parts[2], "ranges="), ",")}
111		for _, text := range strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(parts[3], "ports="), ",") {
112			port, err := strconv.Atoi(text)
113			if err != nil {
114				return false, ErrInvalidScope
115			}
116			request.Ports = append(request.Ports, port)
117		}
118		current, err := s.LANScope(request)
119		if err != nil {
120			return false, err
121		}
122		return current == scope, nil
123	}

125	func (s *Service) prepareLAN(request LANRequest) (lanPlan, error) {
126		if len(request.Ranges) == 0 || len(request.Ranges) > maxLANAddresses {
127			return lanPlan{}, fmt.Errorf("select explicit IPv4 ranges totaling at most %d addresses: %w", maxLANAddresses, ErrInvalidScope)
128		}
129		ports := append([]int(nil), request.Ports...)
130		if len(ports) == 0 {
131			ports = []int{22}
132		}
133		if len(ports) > maxLANPorts {
134			return lanPlan{}, fmt.Errorf("at most %d ports are allowed: %w", maxLANPorts, ErrInvalidScope)
135		}
136		sort.Ints(ports)
137		uniquePorts := ports[:0]
138		for _, port := range ports {
139			if port < 1 || port > 65535 {
140				return lanPlan{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid TCP port: %w", ErrInvalidScope)
141			}
142			if len(uniquePorts) == 0 || uniquePorts[len(uniquePorts)-1] != port {
143				uniquePorts = append(uniquePorts, port)
144			}
145		}
146		ports = uniquePorts
147		addresses := map[netip.Addr]bool{}
148		ranges := map[string]bool{}
149		for _, raw := range request.Ranges {
150			prefix, err := netip.ParsePrefix(raw)
151			if err != nil {
152				address, addrErr := netip.ParseAddr(raw)
153				if addrErr != nil || !address.Is4() {
154					return lanPlan{}, fmt.Errorf("LAN ranges must be literal IPv4 addresses or CIDRs: %w", ErrInvalidScope)
155				}
156				prefix = netip.PrefixFrom(address, 32)
157			}
158			if !prefix.Addr().Is4() || prefix.Bits() < 24 {
159				return lanPlan{}, fmt.Errorf("each LAN range must contain at most %d addresses: %w", maxLANAddresses, ErrInvalidScope)
160			}
161			prefix = prefix.Masked()
162			ranges[prefix.String()] = true
163			for address := prefix.Addr(); address.IsValid() && prefix.Contains(address); address = address.Next() {
164				if !usableIPv4(address) {
165					return lanPlan{}, fmt.Errorf("range includes non-unicast IPv4 addresses: %w", ErrInvalidScope)
166				}
167				addresses[address] = true
168				if len(addresses) > maxLANAddresses {
169					return lanPlan{}, fmt.Errorf("LAN ranges exceed %d addresses: %w", maxLANAddresses, ErrInvalidScope)
170				}
171			}
172		}
173		if len(addresses)*len(ports) > maxLANEndpoints {
174			return lanPlan{}, fmt.Errorf("LAN scope exceeds %d endpoints: %w", maxLANEndpoints, ErrInvalidScope)
175		}
176		scopes, err := s.Interfaces()
177		if err != nil {
178			return lanPlan{}, err
179		}
180		byInterface := map[string][]InterfaceScope{}
181		for _, scope := range scopes {
182			if request.Interface == "" || scope.Interface == request.Interface {
183				key := scope.Interface + "#" + strconv.Itoa(scope.Index)
184				byInterface[key] = append(byInterface[key], scope)
185			}
186		}
187		var matching []string
188		for key, group := range byInterface {
189			containsAll := true
190			for address := range addresses {
191				contained := false
192				for _, scope := range group {
193					prefix, _ := netip.ParsePrefix(scope.Prefix)
194					contained = contained || prefix.Contains(address)
195				}
196				containsAll = containsAll && contained
197			}
198			if containsAll {
199				matching = append(matching, key)
200			}
201		}
202		if len(matching) != 1 {
203			return lanPlan{}, fmt.Errorf("ranges must belong to exactly one selected active broadcast interface: %w", ErrInvalidScope)
204		}
205		group := byInterface[matching[0]]
206		self := map[netip.Addr]bool{}
207		// Exclude every local address, including another interface on the same link.
208		for _, scope := range scopes {
209			address, _ := netip.ParseAddr(scope.Address)
210			self[address] = true
211		}
212		var targets []netip.Addr
213		for address := range addresses {
214			if self[address] {
215				continue
216			}
217			reserved := false
218			for _, scope := range group {
219				prefix, _ := netip.ParsePrefix(scope.Prefix)
220				if prefix.Contains(address) && prefix.Bits() <= 30 {
221					reserved = reserved || address == prefix.Addr() || address == lastIPv4(prefix)
222				}
223			}
224			if !reserved {
225				targets = append(targets, address)
226			}
227		}
228		if len(targets) == 0 {
229			return lanPlan{}, fmt.Errorf("scope contains no remote unicast addresses: %w", ErrInvalidScope)
230		}
231		sort.Slice(targets, func(i, j int) bool { return targets[i].Less(targets[j]) })
232		var rangeNames, interfaceNames, portNames []string
233		for value := range ranges {
234			rangeNames = append(rangeNames, value)
235		}
236		for _, scope := range group {
237			interfaceNames = append(interfaceNames, scope.Address+"/"+scope.Prefix)
238		}
239		for _, port := range ports {
240			portNames = append(portNames, strconv.Itoa(port))
241		}
242		sort.Strings(rangeNames)
243		sort.Strings(interfaceNames)
244		scope := "interface=" + matching[0] + ";onlink=" + strings.Join(interfaceNames, ",") + ";ranges=" + strings.Join(rangeNames, ",") + ";ports=" + strings.Join(portNames, ",")
245		return lanPlan{scope: scope, addresses: targets, ports: ports}, nil
246	}

248	func usableIPv4(address netip.Addr) bool {
249		return address.Is4() && !address.IsUnspecified() && !address.IsLoopback() && !address.IsMulticast() && address != netip.MustParseAddr("255.255.255.255")
250	}
251	
252	func lastIPv4(prefix netip.Prefix) netip.Addr {
253		bytes := prefix.Masked().Addr().As4()
254		bits := uint32(bytes[0])<<24 | uint32(bytes[1])<<16 | uint32(bytes[2])<<8 | uint32(bytes[3])
255		bits |= uint32(0xffffffff) >> uint(prefix.Bits())
256		return netip.AddrFrom4([4]byte{byte(bits >> 24), byte(bits >> 16), byte(bits >> 8), byte(bits)})
257	}

269	// LAN performs only bounded TCP connects and reads server identification. It
270	// never sends an SSH identification, authenticates, or executes a remote
271	// command. A completed scan means its probes ran, not that silent endpoints are
272	// closed or absent. Reverse-DNS names are suggestions and never connection truth.
273	func (s *Service) LAN(ctx context.Context, request LANRequest) (Report, error) {
274		return s.LANWithProgress(ctx, request, nil)
275	}
276	
277	// LANWithProgress has the same bounded, observation-only semantics as LAN.
278	// Completed observations remain in its report even when the scan is canceled.
279	func (s *Service) LANWithProgress(ctx context.Context, request LANRequest, progress func(Progress)) (Report, error) {
280		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(nonNilContext(ctx), lanTimeout)
281		defer cancel()
282		report := s.report(SourceLAN, "")
283		plan, err := s.prepareLAN(request)
284		if err != nil {
285			return report, err
286		}
287		report.Scope = plan.scope
288		total := len(plan.addresses) * len(plan.ports)
289		if progress != nil {
290			progress(Progress{Total: total})
291		}
292		jobs := make(chan lanEndpoint)
293		results := make(chan lanResult, maxLANWorkers)
294		var workers sync.WaitGroup
295		var ptr sync.Map
296		for range min(maxLANWorkers, len(plan.addresses)*len(plan.ports)) {
297			workers.Go(func() {
298				for endpoint := range jobs {
299					if ctx.Err() != nil {
300						return
301					}
302					candidate := s.probeLANEndpoint(ctx, plan.scope, endpoint)
303					if candidate != nil {
304						candidate.DNSName = s.lookupPTR(ctx, endpoint.address.String(), &ptr)
305						if candidate.DNSName != "" {
306							candidate.Name, _, _ = strings.Cut(candidate.DNSName, ".")
307						}
308					}
309					results <- lanResult{candidate: candidate}
310				}
311			})
312		}
313		go func() {
314			defer close(jobs)
315			for _, address := range plan.addresses {
316				for _, port := range plan.ports {
317					select {
318					case jobs <- lanEndpoint{address, port}:
319					case <-ctx.Done():
320						return
321					}
322				}
323			}
324		}()
325		go func() { workers.Wait(); close(results) }()
326		completed := 0
327		for result := range results {
328			completed++
329			if result.candidate != nil {
330				report.Candidates = append(report.Candidates, *result.candidate)
331			}
332			if progress != nil {
333				update := Progress{Completed: completed, Total: total}
334				if result.candidate != nil {
335					copy := *result.candidate
336					copy.Addresses = append([]string(nil), copy.Addresses...)
337					update.Candidate = &copy
338				}
339				progress(update)
340			}
341		}
342		sortCandidates(report.Candidates)
343		report.Complete = ctx.Err() == nil && completed == len(plan.addresses)*len(plan.ports)
344		report.Status = StatusReady
345		if !report.Complete {
346			report.Status = StatusPartial
347			if ctx.Err() != nil {
348				return report, ctx.Err()
349			}
350			return report, errors.New("LAN discovery did not finish every endpoint")
351		}
352		return report, nil
353	}

355	func (s *Service) probeLANEndpoint(ctx context.Context, scope string, endpoint lanEndpoint) *Candidate {
356		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, endpointTimeout)
357		defer cancel()
358		address := net.JoinHostPort(endpoint.address.String(), strconv.Itoa(endpoint.port))
359		conn, err := s.options.DialContext(ctx, "tcp4", address)
360		if err != nil {
361			return nil
362		}
363		defer conn.Close()
364		stop := context.AfterFunc(ctx, func() { _ = conn.Close() })
365		defer stop()
366		deadline, _ := ctx.Deadline()
367		_ = conn.SetReadDeadline(deadline)
368		candidate := &Candidate{Source: SourceLAN, Scope: scope, NativeID: address,
369			Name: endpoint.address.String(), Addresses: []string{endpoint.address.String()}, Port: endpoint.port, State: StateOpen}
370		candidate.ID = candidateID(SourceLAN, scope, address)
371		reader := bufio.NewReaderSize(io.LimitReader(conn, maxBannerBytes), 512)
372		for range 50 {
373			line, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
374			if err != nil {
375				return candidate
376			}
377			line = strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimSuffix(line, "\n"), "\r")
378			if len(line) > 253 || !safeText(line, 253) {
379				return candidate
380			}
381			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "SSH-") {
382				software := strings.TrimPrefix(line, "SSH-2.0-")
383				if software == line {
384					software = strings.TrimPrefix(line, "SSH-1.99-")
385				}
386				if software == line || software == "" || software[0] == ' ' {
387					return candidate
388				}
389				candidate.State = StateSSH
390				candidate.AdvertisesSSH = strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(software), "tailscale")
391				return candidate
392			}
393		}
394		return candidate
395	}
396	
397	func (s *Service) lookupPTR(ctx context.Context, address string, cache *sync.Map) string {
398		entry := &ptrResult{ready: make(chan struct{})}
399		value, loaded := cache.LoadOrStore(address, entry)
400		if loaded {
401			other := value.(*ptrResult)
402			select {
403			case <-other.ready:
404				return other.name
405			case <-ctx.Done():
406				return ""
407			}
408		}
409		defer close(entry.ready)
410		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, ptrTimeout)
411		defer cancel()
412		names, err := s.options.LookupAddr(ctx, address)
413		if err != nil {
414			return ""
415		}
416		var valid []string
417		for _, name := range names {
418			if validDNS(name) {
419				valid = append(valid, strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".")))
420			}
421		}
422		sort.Strings(valid)
423		if len(valid) != 0 {
424			entry.name = valid[0]
425		}
426		return entry.name
427	}
```

```text
21	
22	const cacheVersion = 1
23	const maxCacheFileBytes = 4 << 20
24	const maxCacheTotalBytes = 16 << 20
25	const maxCacheReports = 128
26	
27	type cacheRecord struct {
28		Version int    `json:"version"`
29		Report  Report `json:"report"`
30		// Previous contains only identities absent from a newer partial attempt,
31		// retaining each observation's original time. Old readers ignore this
32		// additive cache field and can still inspect the latest attempt.
33		Previous []Report `json:"previous,omitempty"`
34	}
35	
36	func cacheName(report Report) string {
37		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(report.Scope))
38		return report.Source + "-" + hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]) + ".json"
39	}
40	
41	// WriteCache stores one observation under a source/scope key. It is explicit:
42	// discovery and inventory reads never write cache files. cacheDir must be a
43	// dedicated owner-private directory; missing components are created privately.
44	// It never follows directory/file symlinks, and unsupported ownership platforms
45	// fail closed rather than writing nominally private data with unverifiable ACLs.
46	func WriteCache(ctx context.Context, cacheDir string, report Report) error {
47		ctx = nonNilContext(ctx)
48		if err := validateReport(report); err != nil {
49			return err
50		}
51		root, verify, err := openCacheRoot(cacheDir, true)
52		if err != nil {
53			return err
54		}
55		defer root.Close()
56		name := cacheName(report)
57		before, err := root.Lstat(name)
58		if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
59			return err
60		}
61		record := cacheRecord{Version: cacheVersion, Report: report}
62		if !report.Complete && err == nil {
63			if err := checkCacheFile(filepath.Join(cacheDir, name), before); err != nil {
64				return err
65			}
66			previous, _, err := safefile.ReadStableRegular(ctx, root, name, before, maxCacheFileBytes)
67			if err != nil {
68				return err
69			}
70			var prior cacheRecord
71			if err := json.Unmarshal(previous, &prior); err != nil {
72				return ErrInvalidData
73			}
74			if err := validateCacheRecord(prior, name); err != nil {
75				return err
76			}
77			merged := MergeReports(append([]Report{report, prior.Report}, prior.Previous...))
78			record.Report, record.Previous = merged[0], merged[1:]
79		}
80		if err := validateCacheRecord(record, name); err != nil {
81			return err
82		}
83		data, err := json.Marshal(record)
84		if err != nil {
85			return err
86		}
87		if len(data) > maxCacheFileBytes {
88			return fmt.Errorf("discovery cache report is too large: %w", ErrInvalidData)
89		}
90		if before == nil {
91			if err := verify(); err != nil {
92				return err
93			}
94			_, err = safefile.CreateNoClobberPrepared(ctx, root, name, data, 0o600, prepareCacheStage)
95		} else {
96			if err := checkCacheFile(filepath.Join(cacheDir, name), before); err != nil {
97				return err
98			}
99			if err := verify(); err != nil {
100				return err
101			}
102			_, err = safefile.AtomicReplacePrepared(ctx, root, name, before, data, 0o600, prepareCacheStage)
103		}
104		if err != nil {
105			return err
106		}
107		return verify()
108	}
109	
110	// ReadCache reads all source reports without creating, refreshing, deleting, or
111	// changing any file. Missing caches return an empty slice. Corrupt/unsafe entries
112	// produce an error alongside any independently valid records; callers must keep
113	// that incomplete observation distinct from an empty successful inventory.
114	func ReadCache(ctx context.Context, cacheDir string, now time.Time) ([]Report, error) {
115		ctx = nonNilContext(ctx)
116		if now.IsZero() {
117			now = time.Now()
118		}
119		reports := []Report{}
120		root, verify, err := openCacheRoot(cacheDir, false)
121		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
122			return reports, nil
123		}
124		if err != nil {
125			return reports, err
126		}
127		defer root.Close()
128		directory, err := root.Open(".")
129		if err != nil {
130			return reports, err
131		}
132		entries, err := directory.ReadDir(maxCacheReports + 1)
133		_ = directory.Close()
134		if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
135			return reports, err
136		}
137		if len(entries) > maxCacheReports {
138			return reports, errors.New("too many discovery cache entries")
139		}
140		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Name() < entries[j].Name() })
141		var failures []error
142		var total int64
143		for _, entry := range entries {
144			if ctx.Err() != nil {
145				return reports, ctx.Err()
146			}
147			name := entry.Name()
148			if !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".json") || !(strings.HasPrefix(name, SourceTailscale+"-") || strings.HasPrefix(name, SourceLAN+"-")) {
149				continue
150			}
151			info, err := root.Lstat(name)
152			if err == nil {
153				err = checkCacheFile(filepath.Join(cacheDir, name), info)
154			}
155			if err != nil {
156				failures = append(failures, fmt.Errorf("read discovery cache entry: %w", err))
157				continue
158			}
159			total += info.Size()
160			if total > maxCacheTotalBytes {
161				failures = append(failures, errors.New("discovery cache exceeds total read bound"))
162				break
163			}
164			data, _, err := safefile.ReadStableRegular(ctx, root, name, info, maxCacheFileBytes)
165			if err != nil {
166				failures = append(failures, fmt.Errorf("read discovery cache entry: %w", err))
167				continue
168			}
169			var record cacheRecord
170			if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &record); err != nil {
171				failures = append(failures, fmt.Errorf("invalid discovery cache version or scope: %w", ErrInvalidData))
172				continue
173			}
174			if err := validateCacheRecord(record, name); err != nil {
175				failures = append(failures, err)
176				continue
177			}
178			for _, report := range append([]Report{record.Report}, record.Previous...) {
179				report.Stale = now.Before(report.ObservedAt) || now.Sub(report.ObservedAt) >= CacheTTL
180				reports = append(reports, report)
181			}
182		}
183		if err := verify(); err != nil {
184			return []Report{}, err
185		}
186		return reports, errors.Join(failures...)
187	}

189	func validateCacheRecord(record cacheRecord, name string) error {
190		if record.Version != cacheVersion || cacheName(record.Report) != name || len(record.Previous) > maxLANEndpoints {
191			return ErrInvalidData
192		}
193		seen := map[string]bool{}
194		total := 0
195		for _, report := range append([]Report{record.Report}, record.Previous...) {
196			if report.Source != record.Report.Source || report.Scope != record.Report.Scope {
197				return ErrInvalidData
198			}
199			if err := validateReport(report); err != nil {
200				return err
201			}
202			for _, candidate := range report.Candidates {
203				if seen[candidate.NativeID] {
204					return ErrInvalidData
205				}
206				seen[candidate.NativeID] = true
207				total++
208				if total > maxLANEndpoints {
209					return ErrInvalidData
210				}
211			}
212		}
213		return nil
214	}
215	
216	func validateReport(report Report) error {
217		if report.Source != SourceTailscale && report.Source != SourceLAN {
218			return ErrInvalidData
219		}
220		if !safeText(report.Scope, 32768) || report.Scope == "" || report.ObservedAt.IsZero() || len(report.Candidates) > maxLANEndpoints {
221			return ErrInvalidData
222		}
223		switch report.Status {
224		case StatusReady:
225			if !report.Complete {
226				return ErrInvalidData
227			}
228		case StatusPartial, StatusFailed, StatusUnavailable:
229			if report.Complete {
230				return ErrInvalidData
231			}
232		default:
233			return ErrInvalidData
234		}
235		seen := map[string]bool{}
236		for _, candidate := range report.Candidates {
237			if candidate.Source != report.Source || candidate.Scope != report.Scope || candidate.ID == "" || candidate.NativeID == "" ||
238				candidate.ID != candidateID(candidate.Source, candidate.Scope, candidate.NativeID) || seen[candidate.ID] || !safeText(candidate.NativeID, 1024) ||
239				!safeText(candidate.Name, 256) || !safeText(candidate.OS, 64) || candidate.DNSName != "" && !validDNS(candidate.DNSName) || candidate.Port < 1 || candidate.Port > 65535 ||
240				len(candidate.Addresses) == 0 || len(candidate.Addresses) > 32 {
241				return ErrInvalidData
242			}
243			seen[candidate.ID] = true
244			if candidate.State != StateDiscovered && candidate.State != StateSSH && candidate.State != StateOpen {
245				return ErrInvalidData
246			}
247			for _, raw := range candidate.Addresses {
248				address, err := netip.ParseAddr(raw)
249				if err != nil || address.Zone() != "" || address.IsUnspecified() || address.IsLoopback() || address.IsMulticast() {
250					return ErrInvalidData
251				}
252			}
253		}
254		return nil
255	}
256	
257	// The root walk rejects every symlink component, while held os.Root handles
258	// prevent a changed path from redirecting reads or writes outside the walked
259	// tree. verify rechecks every named component before and after publication.
260	func openCacheRoot(path string, create bool) (*os.Root, func() error, error) {
261		if err := cachePlatformSupported(); err != nil {
262			return nil, nil, err
263		}
264		if !filepath.IsAbs(path) || filepath.Clean(path) != path || path == string(filepath.Separator) {
265			return nil, nil, ErrUnsafeCache
266		}
267		volume := filepath.VolumeName(path)
268		base := volume + string(filepath.Separator)
269		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(base)
270		if err != nil {
271			return nil, nil, err
272		}
273		if err := checkCacheAncestor(base, rootInfo); err != nil {
274			root.Close()
275			return nil, nil, err
276		}
277		type heldDirectory struct {
278			path string
279			info fs.FileInfo
280		}
281		held := []heldDirectory{{path: base, info: rootInfo}}
282		components := strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(path, base), string(filepath.Separator))
283		currentPath := base
284		for index, component := range components {
285			if component == "" || component == "." || component == ".." {
286				root.Close()
287				return nil, nil, ErrUnsafeCache
288			}
289			currentPath = filepath.Join(currentPath, component)
290			info, err := root.Lstat(component)
291			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) && create {
292				err = root.Mkdir(component, 0o700)
293				if err == nil {
294					err = setCachePrivate(currentPath, 0o700)
295				}
296				if err == nil || errors.Is(err, fs.ErrExist) {
297					info, err = root.Lstat(component)
298				}
299			}
300			if err != nil {
301				root.Close()
302				return nil, nil, err
303			}
304			if index == len(components)-1 {
305				err = checkCacheDirectory(currentPath, info)
306			} else {
307				err = checkCacheAncestor(currentPath, info)
308			}
309			if err != nil {
310				root.Close()
311				return nil, nil, err
312			}
313			child, childInfo, err := safefile.OpenChildRoot(root, component)
314			root.Close()
315			if err != nil {
316				return nil, nil, err
317			}
318			root = child
319			held = append(held, heldDirectory{path: currentPath, info: childInfo})
320		}
321		verify := func() error {
322			for index, directory := range held {
323				if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(directory.path, directory.info); err != nil {
324					return err
325				}
326				info, err := os.Lstat(directory.path)
327				if err != nil {
328					return err
329				}
330				if index == len(held)-1 {
331					err = checkCacheDirectory(directory.path, info)
332				} else {
333					err = checkCacheAncestor(directory.path, info)
334				}
335				if err != nil {
336					return err
337				}
338			}
339			return nil
340		}
341		if err := verify(); err != nil {
342			root.Close()
343			return nil, nil, err
344		}
345		return root, verify, nil
346	}
347	
348	func prepareCacheStage(file *os.File) error {
349		return setCachePrivate(file.Name(), 0o600)
350	}
```

I now have a complete picture. Here's the report.

## LAN scan mechanism

`dev ssh discover --source lan` does **not** use ARP, ICMP ping, or raw sockets. It is a bounded **TCP connect scan with optional SSH-banner read and reverse-DNS lookup**, nothing more.

- `internal/sshdiscovery/lan.go:355-395` (`probeLANEndpoint`): for each `(address, port)` pair it does `net.Dialer.DialContext(ctx, "tcp4", host:port)` with a 1s timeout (`endpointTimeout`, line 24). If the dial fails (connection refused/timeout/filtered), the function returns `nil` — **no candidate is recorded at all**, not even a "closed" or "unreachable" entry.
- If the TCP connect succeeds, it optionally reads up to 4096 bytes / 50 lines looking for an `SSH-` banner (lines 371-393) to classify state as `open_unknown` vs `ssh_banner`.
- Reverse-DNS (`lookupPTR`, lines 397-427) is a best-effort 500ms PTR lookup, advisory only.
- Concurrency: up to 32 workers (`maxLANWorkers`), overall scan capped at 30s (`lanTimeout`, line 23), and the request itself is capped at 256 addresses (`maxLANAddresses`), 16 ports (`maxLANPorts`), 4096 endpoints total (`maxLANEndpoints`).
- Default port list is `[]int{22}` if `--ports` isn't given (`internal/cli/ssh_machines.go:237`, and `lan.go:130-132`). So **any host on the LAN that doesn't have TCP/22 open will simply never appear**, regardless of whether it's alive.
- `net.Interfaces()` (line 30) is used only to enumerate local interface/CIDR metadata for validation — it sends no packets and is unrelated to host discovery.

There is explicitly no ARP-table read, no ICMP, no mDNS/Bonjour, and no IPv6 support — the doc at `docs/guides/ssh-hosts.md:427-431` states this directly: *"Discovery performs bounded TCP/banner checks and reverse-DNS lookups, without SSH authentication... IPv6 range scans, mDNS and background scans are not implemented."*

## What "ready" actually means

`StatusReady` (`internal/sshdiscovery/types.go:18`) means **the scan finished probing every planned endpoint before the 30s deadline** — it says nothing about whether any device was found.

- `lan.go:343-351`: `report.Complete = ctx.Err() == nil && completed == len(plan.addresses)*len(plan.ports))`; `report.Status = StatusReady` is set whenever `Complete` becomes true. If the context times out or is canceled mid-scan, status becomes `StatusPartial` instead.
- `cache.go:223-234` (`validateReport`) enforces the invariant explicitly: `StatusReady` requires `Complete == true`, and `StatusPartial/StatusFailed/StatusUnavailable` require `Complete == false`. There's no status tied to "candidates found."
- So a report with `Status: "ready"`, `Complete: true`, and `Candidates: []` is entirely valid and expected on a network where nothing answered TCP/22 — this is precisely the "success but zero devices" symptom the user described.
- `types.go:58-60` documents this as intentional: *"Report describes one explicit discovery attempt, including incomplete ones... Cached reports retain their observation time and are never authentication authority."* The "ready" word describes scan completion, not host presence.

## ObservedAt / Stale

- `ObservedAt` (`types.go:65`) is set once per report to `s.options.Now().UTC()` at the start of the attempt (`types.go:141-144`, `s.report(...)`).
- `Stale` is computed only at read time in `ReadCache` (`cache.go:179`): `report.Stale = now.Before(report.ObservedAt) || now.Sub(report.ObservedAt) >= CacheTTL`, where `CacheTTL = 5 * time.Minute` (`types.go:27`). It is not stored in the cache file itself.

## macOS-specific behavior / permissions

No macOS-specific code, no sudo/root requirement, and no reference to Apple's Local Network privacy prompt exist anywhere in `internal/sshdiscovery` or the docs (`grep` for `macos|Local Network|raw socket|sudo|firewall|icmp|ping` in `internal/sshdiscovery/*.go` returned only the unrelated `net.Interfaces()` call). Because the mechanism is a plain outbound TCP4 connect (userspace socket, no multicast/broadcast, no raw ICMP), it does **not** need root/sudo and does not use APIs that require macOS's Local Network entitlement/permission (that permission gates mDNS/Bonjour and broadcast/raw operations, not the ordinary unicast TCP dial used here). That said, this is inferred from the code — the docs never explicitly rule out the OS possibly showing that permission prompt for the `dev` binary; there is simply no code path relying on it.

## Where the user sees results

There's no separate command — `dev ssh discover --source lan ...` itself prints the results:

- `internal/cli/ssh_machines.go:304-315` (`renderSSHDiscovery`): prints one status line — `"%s discovery: %s (observed %s; stale=%t)\n"` — followed by a table with columns `SELECTOR, NAME, ADDRESS, OS, STATE, TAILSCALE SSH`, one row per candidate. If zero candidates were found, this literally renders as a status line saying `lan discovery: ready (...)` plus an **empty table with just headers** — no explicit "0 devices found" or warning message distinguishing "nothing was there" from "we didn't scan." This is exactly the confusing "success but empty" UX.
- `dev ssh list --lan` (`docs/guides/ssh-hosts.md:409, 434`) is a separate, related command, but it explicitly reads the disposable cache under `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/ssh-discovery/` — *"never scans"* — so it can't surface anything `discover` didn't already find.
- `--json` mode (`ssh_machines.go:219-226`) emits the same `Report` (source/status/scope/candidates/observed_at/complete) as structured JSON for scripting.
- Successful reports (`len(Candidates) > 0 || Complete`) are written to the on-disk cache (`ssh_machines.go:296-300`, `cache.go:46`); a zero-candidate-but-complete scan is still written to cache (since `Complete` is true), so a subsequent `dev ssh list --lan` or non-`--refresh` `discover` will keep echoing the same empty result for up to 5 minutes without re-probing.

## Why zero devices are commonly found on a real LAN

1. **Only TCP/22 is probed by default.** Any host that doesn't run an SSH server (routers, phones, smart-TVs, printers, most consumer devices) is invisible, even though it's alive on the network (`ssh_machines.go:237`, `lan.go:130-132`).
2. **No fallback beyond TCP connect.** If a host's firewall silently drops (rather than resets) unsolicited SYNs to port 22 — very common default behavior — the 1-second per-endpoint timeout (`endpointTimeout`, `lan.go:24`) just expires and that host is skipped entirely, with no distinct "filtered" vs "closed" observation.
3. **1-second per-endpoint / 30-second total budget.** On congested Wi-Fi or when scanning many addresses with multiple ports, endpoints can legitimately time out before a real (but momentarily slow) TCP handshake completes, especially since the scanner also has to fit reverse-DNS lookups inside the same window.
4. **User must supply the correct interface/CIDR explicitly.** `prepareLAN` (`lan.go:125-246`) requires the address set to be fully contained in exactly one currently active, non-loopback, broadcast-capable interface's prefix (`lan.go:187-204`); if `--interface`/`--cidr` mismatch the true local subnet (e.g., scanning `192.168.31.0/24` while the machine is actually on `192.168.1.0/24`, or the VPN/Tailscale interface is picked up ambiguously), the command still succeeds with `Complete: true` but finds nothing because it scanned the wrong network entirely.
5. **Stale cache masking a fixed problem.** Because a `Complete: true`, zero-candidate report is cached for 5 minutes (`CacheTTL`, `types.go:27`) and reused unless `--refresh` is passed (`ssh_machines.go:283-289`), retrying `discover` without `--refresh` after fixing the CIDR/network will just replay the old empty result.
6. **No ARP fallback.** Since the scanner never reads the OS ARP table, a host that's reachable at the link layer but has SSH disabled or firewalled will never show up as "seen" the way `arp -a` or a ping sweep would.
7. **Reserved addresses excluded.** Network/broadcast addresses of any contained subnet with prefix ≤/30 are explicitly excluded from probing (`lan.go:216-224`), and the local machine's own addresses are excluded (`lan.go:206-214`) — expected, not a bug, but worth knowing if a user expects to see their own gateway or router IP.

### Key files/lines for follow-up
- `internal/cli/ssh_machines.go:199-315` — CLI command, cache lookup/write, rendering.
- `internal/sshdiscovery/lan.go:18-27,125-246,273-395` — constants, scope/plan validation, scan/probe implementation.
- `internal/sshdiscovery/types.go:14-28,58-69,141-144` — status/state constants, `Report`/`Candidate` semantics.
- `internal/sshdiscovery/cache.go:216-255` — status/completeness invariants enforced on read/write.
- `internal/sshdiscovery/lan_test.go:38-96,129-149,150-195,257-276` — tests documenting banner-only/advisory PTR behavior, exclusion of network/broadcast addresses, partial/canceled scan semantics.
- `docs/guides/ssh-hosts.md:417-436` and `internal/skill/dev-cli/references/ssh-hosts.md:463-467` — the only prose documentation of these limits (port-22 default, 256/16/4096/32/30s bounds, no IPv6/mDNS/background scans, 5-minute cache).

2. **No fallback beyond TCP connect.** If a host's firewall silently drops (rather than resets) unsolicited SYNs to port 22 — very common default behavior — the 1-second per-endpoint timeout (`endpointTimeout`, `lan.go:24`) just expires and that host is skipped entirely, with no distinct "filtered" vs "closed" observation.
3. **1-second per-endpoint / 30-second total budget.** On congested Wi-Fi or when scanning many addresses with multiple ports, endpoints can legitimately time out before a real (but momentarily slow) TCP handshake completes, especially since the scanner also has to fit reverse-DNS lookups inside the same window.
4. **User must supply the correct interface/CIDR explicitly.** `prepareLAN` (`lan.go:125-246`) requires the address set to be fully contained in exactly one currently active, non-loopback, broadcast-capable interface's prefix (`lan.go:187-204`); if `--interface`/`--cidr` mismatch the true local subnet (e.g., scanning `192.168.31.0/24` while the machine is actually on `192.168.1.0/24`, or the VPN/Tailscale interface is picked up ambiguously), the command still succeeds with `Complete: true` but finds nothing because it scanned the wrong network entirely.
5. **Stale cache masking a fixed problem.** Because a `Complete: true`, zero-candidate report is cached for 5 minutes (`CacheTTL`, `types.go:27`) and reused unless `--refresh` is passed (`ssh_machines.go:283-289`), retrying `discover` without `--refresh` after fixing the CIDR/network will just replay the old empty result.
6. **No ARP fallback.** Since the scanner never reads the OS ARP table, a host that's reachable at the link layer but has SSH disabled or firewalled will never show up as "seen" the way `arp -a` or a ping sweep would.
7. **Reserved addresses excluded.** Network/broadcast addresses of any contained subnet with prefix ≤/30 are explicitly excluded from probing (`lan.go:216-224`), and the local machine's own addresses are excluded (`lan.go:206-214`) — expected, not a bug, but worth knowing if a user expects to see their own gateway or router IP.

### Key files/lines for follow-up
- `internal/cli/ssh_machines.go:199-315` — CLI command, cache lookup/write, rendering.
- `internal/sshdiscovery/lan.go:18-27,125-246,273-395` — constants, scope/plan validation, scan/probe implementation.
- `internal/sshdiscovery/types.go:14-28,58-69,141-144` — status/state constants, `Report`/`Candidate` semantics.
- `internal/sshdiscovery/cache.go:216-255` — status/completeness invariants enforced on read/write.
- `internal/sshdiscovery/lan_test.go:38-96,129-149,150-195,257-276` — tests documenting banner-only/advisory PTR behavior, exclusion of network/broadcast addresses, partial/canceled scan semantics.
- `docs/guides/ssh-hosts.md:417-436` and `internal/skill/dev-cli/references/ssh-hosts.md:463-467` — the only prose documentation of these limits (port-22 default, 256/16/4096/32/30s bounds, no IPv6/mDNS/background scans, 5-minute cache).</result>

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-09-13 12:59:07Z)**_

我幫你查清楚了，這其實不是 bug，而是 `dev ssh discover --source lan` 這個掃描機制本身的限制。你看到的輸出：

```
lan discovery: ready (observed 2026-09-13T12:55:29Z; stale=false)
```

`ready` 只代表「掃描在 30 秒內完整跑完了所有目標」，**跟有沒有找到任何裝置完全無關**。如果掃描完但下面沒有出現任何一列 SELECTOR/NAME/ADDRESS/... 的資料，就代表這次掃描實際上是「0 台裝置」，只是介面沒有明確印出「找到 0 個」這種訊息，看起來像是失敗。

## 為什麼會掃到 0 台

這個 LAN 掃描（`internal/sshdiscovery/lan.go`）**不是** ARP、也不是 ICMP ping，而是純粹的 **TCP connect scan**：

1. **預設只探測 TCP/22（SSH port）**。你網路上任何沒開 SSH 服務的裝置（路由器、手機、電視、印表機…）天生就不會被發現，即使它明明活著在網路上。要掃別的 port 得自己加 `--ports`。
2. **沒有 fallback、沒有 ARP。** 如果對方防火牆是「靜默丟包」（不回 RST，很多裝置預設就是這樣），連線會直接 timeout（每個目標 1 秒），不會被記錄成「filtered」，只是直接消失，不會出現在結果裡。
3. **CIDR/介面要對。** 掃描要求輸入的 CIDR 完全落在你這台機器目前某張有效、非 loopback 網卡的子網段內。如果你輸入的 `192.168.31.0/24` 其實不是你目前實際連上的子網（比如你人在別的 Wi-Fi、或有 VPN/Tailscale 介面搶走判斷），掃描依然會回報「complete/ready」，但因為掃錯網段，自然什麼都掃不到。
4. **結果會被快取 5 分鐘。** 就算你之後修正了問題重跑，若沒加 `--refresh`，會直接吃到剛剛那個「0 台裝置」的舊結果。

## 建議排查步驟

1. 確認你目前真正連上的網段：`ifconfig` 或 `ipconfig getifaddr en0` 看你機器實際的 IP/子網，跟你輸入的 CIDR 是否一致。
2. 用 `--refresh` 強制重新掃描，避免吃到快取。
3. 試著手動指定其他 port，例如常見的 80/443，看看是不是只是「這網段裡沒人開 22」：
   ```
   dev ssh discover --source lan --ports 22,80,443
   ```
4. 用 `arp -a` 或 `ping` 手動確認同網段內是否真的有其他裝置在線、且防火牆有沒有擋 SYN。

一句話總結：不是 dev 壞了，是這個功能本來就只做「有限的 TCP/22 探測」，不是完整的網路探索工具，`ready` 也只代表掃描動作完成，不代表有找到東西。

```text
dev () {
	case "${1:-}" in
		(__complete|__completeNoDesc|--help|-h|--version|--skill|completion|config|doctor|retire|prepare|artifact|git|edit|gitignore|ignore|help|list|ls|park|skill|shell-init|cache|stats|status|sweep|adopt|bootstrap) command /opt/homebrew/bin/dev "$@" || return $?
			return 0 ;;
	esac
	local __dev_cd_file __dev_action_file __dev_dir __dev_status
	local __dev_action __dev_task __dev_delete __dev_unknown
	if ! __dev_cd_file="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/dev-cd.XXXXXX" 2>/dev/null)" 
	then
		__dev_cd_file="$(mktemp "/tmp/dev-cd.XXXXXX" 2>/dev/null)"  || {
			printf 'dev: cannot create the shell directory side channel\n' >&2
			return 1
		}
	fi
	if ! __dev_action_file="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/dev-action.XXXXXX" 2>/dev/null)" 
	then
		__dev_action_file="$(mktemp "/tmp/dev-action.XXXXXX" 2>/dev/null)"  || {
			rm -f -- "$__dev_cd_file" || :
			printf 'dev: cannot create the shell action side channel\n' >&2
			return 1
		}
	fi
	__dev_status=0 
	DEV_SHELL_CD_FD=3 DEV_SHELL_ACTION_FD=4 command /opt/homebrew/bin/dev "$@" 3> "$__dev_cd_file" 4> "$__dev_action_file" || __dev_status=$? 
	if [ $__dev_status -eq 0 ] && [ -s "$__dev_cd_file" ]
	then
		if IFS= read -r -d '' __dev_dir < "$__dev_cd_file"
		then
			if [ -n "$__dev_dir" ]
			then
				builtin cd -- "$__dev_dir" || __dev_status=$? 
			fi
		else
			__dev_status=1 
		fi
	fi
	if [ $__dev_status -eq 0 ] && [ -s "$__dev_action_file" ]
	then
		exec 4< "$__dev_action_file"
		if IFS= read -r -d '' __dev_action <&4 && IFS= read -r -d '' __dev_task <&4 && IFS= read -r -d '' __dev_delete <&4 && IFS= read -r -d '' __dev_unknown <&4 && {
				[ "$__dev_action" = retire ] || [ "$__dev_action" = retire-recursive ]
			}
		then
			if [ "$__dev_action" = retire-recursive ]
			then
				case "$__dev_delete:$__dev_unknown" in
					(false:false) command /opt/homebrew/bin/dev retire --recursive -- "$__dev_task" || __dev_status=$?  ;;
					(true:false) command /opt/homebrew/bin/dev retire --recursive --delete-branch -- "$__dev_task" || __dev_status=$?  ;;
					(false:true) command /opt/homebrew/bin/dev retire --recursive --close-unknown -- "$__dev_task" || __dev_status=$?  ;;
					(true:true) command /opt/homebrew/bin/dev retire --recursive --delete-branch --close-unknown -- "$__dev_task" || __dev_status=$?  ;;
					(*) __dev_status=1  ;;
				esac
			else
				case "$__dev_delete:$__dev_unknown" in
					(false:false) command /opt/homebrew/bin/dev retire -- "$__dev_task" || __dev_status=$?  ;;
					(true:false) command /opt/homebrew/bin/dev retire --delete-branch -- "$__dev_task" || __dev_status=$?  ;;
					(false:true) command /opt/homebrew/bin/dev retire --close-unknown -- "$__dev_task" || __dev_status=$?  ;;
					(true:true) command /opt/homebrew/bin/dev retire --delete-branch --close-unknown -- "$__dev_task" || __dev_status=$?  ;;
					(*) __dev_status=1  ;;
				esac
			fi
		else
			__dev_status=1 
		fi
		exec 4<&-
	fi
	rm -f -- "$__dev_cd_file" "$__dev_action_file" || :
	return $__dev_status
}
```

```text
270	// never sends an SSH identification, authenticates, or executes a remote
271	// command. A completed scan means its probes ran, not that silent endpoints are
272	// closed or absent. Reverse-DNS names are suggestions and never connection truth.
273	func (s *Service) LAN(ctx context.Context, request LANRequest) (Report, error) {
274		return s.LANWithProgress(ctx, request, nil)
275	}
276	
277	// LANWithProgress has the same bounded, observation-only semantics as LAN.
278	// Completed observations remain in its report even when the scan is canceled.
279	func (s *Service) LANWithProgress(ctx context.Context, request LANRequest, progress func(Progress)) (Report, error) {
280		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(nonNilContext(ctx), lanTimeout)
281		defer cancel()
282		report := s.report(SourceLAN, "")
283		plan, err := s.prepareLAN(request)
284		if err != nil {
285			return report, err
286		}
287		report.Scope = plan.scope
288		total := len(plan.addresses) * len(plan.ports)
289		if progress != nil {
290			progress(Progress{Total: total})
291		}
292		jobs := make(chan lanEndpoint)
293		results := make(chan lanResult, maxLANWorkers)
294		var workers sync.WaitGroup
295		var ptr sync.Map
296		for range min(maxLANWorkers, len(plan.addresses)*len(plan.ports)) {
297			workers.Go(func() {
298				for endpoint := range jobs {
299					if ctx.Err() != nil {
300						return
301					}
302					candidate := s.probeLANEndpoint(ctx, plan.scope, endpoint)
303					if candidate != nil {
304						candidate.DNSName = s.lookupPTR(ctx, endpoint.address.String(), &ptr)
305						if candidate.DNSName != "" {
306							candidate.Name, _, _ = strings.Cut(candidate.DNSName, ".")
307						}
308					}
309					results <- lanResult{candidate: candidate}
310				}
311			})
312		}
313		go func() {
314			defer close(jobs)
315			for _, address := range plan.addresses {
316				for _, port := range plan.ports {
317					select {
318					case jobs <- lanEndpoint{address, port}:
319					case <-ctx.Done():
320						return
321					}
322				}
323			}
324		}()
325		go func() { workers.Wait(); close(results) }()
326		completed := 0
327		for result := range results {
328			completed++
329			if result.candidate != nil {
330				report.Candidates = append(report.Candidates, *result.candidate)
331			}
332			if progress != nil {
333				update := Progress{Completed: completed, Total: total}
334				if result.candidate != nil {
335					copy := *result.candidate
336					copy.Addresses = append([]string(nil), copy.Addresses...)
337					update.Candidate = &copy
338				}
339				progress(update)
340			}
341		}
342		sortCandidates(report.Candidates)
343		report.Complete = ctx.Err() == nil && completed == len(plan.addresses)*len(plan.ports)
344		report.Status = StatusReady
345		if !report.Complete {
346			report.Status = StatusPartial
347			if ctx.Err() != nil {
348				return report, ctx.Err()
349			}
350			return report, errors.New("LAN discovery did not finish every endpoint")
351		}
352		return report, nil
353	}

355	func (s *Service) probeLANEndpoint(ctx context.Context, scope string, endpoint lanEndpoint) *Candidate {
356		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, endpointTimeout)
357		defer cancel()
358		address := net.JoinHostPort(endpoint.address.String(), strconv.Itoa(endpoint.port))
359		conn, err := s.options.DialContext(ctx, "tcp4", address)
360		if err != nil {
361			return nil
362		}
363		defer conn.Close()
364		stop := context.AfterFunc(ctx, func() { _ = conn.Close() })
365		defer stop()
366		deadline, _ := ctx.Deadline()
367		_ = conn.SetReadDeadline(deadline)
368		candidate := &Candidate{Source: SourceLAN, Scope: scope, NativeID: address,
369			Name: endpoint.address.String(), Addresses: []string{endpoint.address.String()}, Port: endpoint.port, State: StateOpen}
370		candidate.ID = candidateID(SourceLAN, scope, address)
371		reader := bufio.NewReaderSize(io.LimitReader(conn, maxBannerBytes), 512)
372		for range 50 {
373			line, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
374			if err != nil {
375				return candidate
376			}
377			line = strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimSuffix(line, "\n"), "\r")
378			if len(line) > 253 || !safeText(line, 253) {
379				return candidate
380			}
381			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "SSH-") {
382				software := strings.TrimPrefix(line, "SSH-2.0-")
383				if software == line {
384					software = strings.TrimPrefix(line, "SSH-1.99-")
385				}
386				if software == line || software == "" || software[0] == ' ' {
387					return candidate
388				}
389				candidate.State = StateSSH
390				candidate.AdvertisesSSH = strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(software), "tailscale")
391				return candidate
392			}
393		}
394		return candidate
```

_**Agent (claude-opus-5 2026-09-13 13:03:40Z)**_

找到原因了，而且可以重現。你預填的範圍沒問題，真正的問題是 **macOS 的「區域網路」權限擋掉了 `dev` 的連線**，而 `dev` 又把這個錯誤默默吞掉，所以看起來像是「成功但沒有裝置」。

## 預填範圍：合理
- `en1` 的 IP 是 `192.168.31.172/24`，預設閘道 `192.168.31.1`，所以 `192.168.31.0/24` 就是你實際的網段。
- ARP 表裡有大約 11 台活著的裝置，而且這次掃描確實有探測整段 `/24`（JSON 的 `scope` 是 `interface=en1 … ranges=192.168.31.0/24;ports=22`）。
- Clash Verge 的 TUN（`utun9`）沒有攔到這個網段，往 `192.168.31.x` 的路由是直接走 `en1`。

## 實測結果
| 測試 | `.27:22` | `.52:22` | `.1:80`（路由器） |
|---|---|---|---|
| Apple 內建的 `nc` | 通 | 通 | 通 |
| 我在這台機器編的 Go 小程式 | `connect: no route to host` | `no route to host` | 通 |
| `dev ssh discover --refresh --json` | `"status": "ready", "candidates": []` | | |

用 `nc` 看，至少有 4 台開著 SSH：`.27`、`.52`、`.67`、`.138`。同一個 shell 裡，Apple 簽署的系統工具連得上，第三方 Go 二進位檔卻得到 `no route to host`。這正是 macOS 15 之後「區域網路」隱私權限拒絕連線時的樣子，你的系統是 macOS 26.6.2。

權限是算在「負責的 App」身上。從 process 鏈看，你的 shell 是 `~/.local/bin/herdr` 開的，而它是由 launchd 直接啟動的一般 CLI 執行檔，不是 `.app`。這種程式通常跳不出權限提示，也不會出現在設定清單裡。所以很可能從 herdr 裡跑出來的所有非 Apple 程式都連不到區域網路上的其他主機。這點我無法直接讀出權限狀態，是依證據推斷的。

## 怎麼解決
1. 在一個有區域網路權限的一般終端機 App（Terminal.app、Ghostty、iTerm2…）裡，直接跑：
   ```
   /opt/homebrew/bin/dev ssh discover --source lan --cidr 192.168.31.0/24 --refresh
   ```
   第一次會跳出權限提示，也可以到「系統設定 → 隱私權與安全性 → 區域網路」手動打開那個 App。正常的話應該會列出 `.27`、`.52`、`.67`、`.138`。
2. 如果要在 herdr 裡用，就得讓 herdr 的連線算到一個有權限的 `.app` 名下。例如從上面那種終端機 App 裡啟動 herdr，而不是讓 launchd 直接開。

## dev 本身也有 bug
`internal/sshdiscovery/lan.go:360-361` 的 `probeLANEndpoint` 遇到任何 dial 錯誤都直接 `return nil`。所以就算 254 個位址全部是權限造成的 `no route to host`，報告還是 `ready`、`complete`、0 台，使用者完全看不出是被擋。

比較合理的做法是統計錯誤種類。如果 ARP 表裡看得到的主機都回 `EHOSTUNREACH`，但閘道連得上，就把結果標成警告，並提示去開 macOS 區域網路權限，而不是回報 `ready`。要的話我可以直接把這個改進做出來。

```text
   111	// ReadCache reads all source reports without creating, refreshing, deleting, or
   112	// changing any file. Missing caches return an empty slice. Corrupt/unsafe entries
   113	// produce an error alongside any independently valid records; callers must keep
   114	// that incomplete observation distinct from an empty successful inventory.
   115	func ReadCache(ctx context.Context, cacheDir string, now time.Time) ([]Report, error) {
   116		ctx = nonNilContext(ctx)
   117		if now.IsZero() {
   118			now = time.Now()
   119		}
   120		reports := []Report{}
   121		root, verify, err := openCacheRoot(cacheDir, false)
   122		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
   123			return reports, nil
   124		}
   125		if err != nil {
   126			return reports, err
   127		}
   128		defer root.Close()
   129		directory, err := root.Open(".")
   130		if err != nil {
   131			return reports, err
   132		}
   133		entries, err := directory.ReadDir(maxCacheReports + 1)
   134		_ = directory.Close()
   135		if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
   136			return reports, err
   137		}
   138		if len(entries) > maxCacheReports {
   139			return reports, errors.New("too many discovery cache entries")
   140		}
   141		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Name() < entries[j].Name() })
   142		var failures []error
   143		var total int64
   144		for _, entry := range entries {
   145			if ctx.Err() != nil {
   146				return reports, ctx.Err()
   147			}
   148			name := entry.Name()
   149			if !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".json") || !(strings.HasPrefix(name, SourceTailscale+"-") || strings.HasPrefix(name, SourceLAN+"-")) {
   150				continue
   151			}
   152			info, err := root.Lstat(name)
   153			if err == nil {
   154				err = checkCacheFile(filepath.Join(cacheDir, name), info)
   155			}
   156			if err != nil {
   157				failures = append(failures, fmt.Errorf("read discovery cache entry: %w", err))
   158				continue
   159			}
   160			total += info.Size()
   161			if total > maxCacheTotalBytes {
   162				failures = append(failures, errors.New("discovery cache exceeds total read bound"))
   163				break
   164			}
   165			data, _, err := safefile.ReadStableRegular(ctx, root, name, info, maxCacheFileBytes)
   166			if err != nil {
   167				failures = append(failures, fmt.Errorf("read discovery cache entry: %w", err))
   168				continue
   169			}
   170			var record cacheRecord
   171			if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &record); err != nil {
   172				failures = append(failures, fmt.Errorf("invalid discovery cache version or scope: %w", ErrInvalidData))
   173				continue
   174			}
   175			if err := validateCacheRecord(record, name); err != nil {
   176				failures = append(failures, err)
   177				continue
   178			}
   179			for _, report := range append([]Report{record.Report}, record.Previous...) {
   180				report.Stale = now.Before(report.ObservedAt) || now.Sub(report.ObservedAt) >= CacheTTL
   181				reports = append(reports, report)
   182			}
   183		}
   184		if err := verify(); err != nil {
   185			return []Report{}, err
   186		}
   187		return reports, errors.Join(failures...)
   188	}

   190	func validateCacheRecord(record cacheRecord, name string) error {
   191		if record.Version != cacheVersion || cacheName(record.Report) != name || len(record.Previous) > maxLANEndpoints {
   192			return ErrInvalidData
   193		}
   194		seen := map[string]bool{}
   195		total := 0
   196		for _, report := range append([]Report{record.Report}, record.Previous...) {
   197			if report.Source != record.Report.Source || report.Scope != record.Report.Scope {
   198				return ErrInvalidData
   199			}
   200			if err := validateReport(report); err != nil {
   201				return err
   202			}
   203			for _, candidate := range report.Candidates {
   204				if seen[candidate.NativeID] {
   205					return ErrInvalidData
   206				}
   207				seen[candidate.NativeID] = true
   208				total++
   209				if total > maxLANEndpoints {
   210					return ErrInvalidData
   211				}
   212			}
   213		}
   214		return nil
   215	}

   258	// The root walk rejects every symlink component, while held os.Root handles

   261	func openCacheRoot(path string, create bool) (*os.Root, func() error, error) {

   264		}

   274		if err != nil {
   275			return nil, nil, err
   276		}
   277		if err := checkCacheAncestor(base, rootInfo); err != nil {
   278			root.Close()
   279			return nil, nil, err
   280		}
   281		type heldDirectory struct {
   282			path string
   283			info fs.FileInfo
   284		}
   285		held := []heldDirectory{{path: base, info: rootInfo}}
   286		components := strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(path, base), string(filepath.Separator)), string(filepath.Separator))
   287		currentPath := base
   288		for index, component := range components {
   289			if component == "" || component == "." || component == ".." {
   290				root.Close()
   291				return nil, nil, ErrUnsafeCache
   292			}
   293			currentPath = filepath.Join(currentPath, component)
   294			info, err := root.Lstat(component)
   295			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) && create {
   296				err = root.Mkdir(component, 0o700)
   297				if err == nil {
   298					err = setCachePrivate(currentPath, 0o700)

   300				if err == nil || errors.Is(err, fs.ErrExist) {

   303			}
```

```text
28	type cacheRecord struct {
29		Version int    `json:"version"`

37	func cacheName(report Report) string {
38		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(report.Scope))
39		return report.Source + "-" + hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]) + ".json"
40	}

42	// WriteCache stores one observation under a source/scope key. It is explicit:
43	// discovery and inventory reads never write cache files. cacheDir must be a
44	// dedicated owner-private directory; missing components are created privately.
45	// It never follows directory/file symlinks, and unsupported ownership platforms
46	// fail closed rather than writing nominally private data with unverifiable ACLs.
47	func WriteCache(ctx context.Context, cacheDir string, report Report) error {
48		ctx = nonNilContext(ctx)
49		if err := validateReport(report); err != nil {
50			return err
51		}
52		root, verify, err := openCacheRoot(cacheDir, true)
53		if err != nil {
54			return err
55		}
56		defer root.Close()
57		name := cacheName(report)
58		before, err := root.Lstat(name)
59		if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
60			return err
61		}
62		record := cacheRecord{Version: cacheVersion, Report: report}
63		if !report.Complete && err == nil {
64			if err := checkCacheFile(filepath.Join(cacheDir, name), before); err != nil {
65				return err
66			}
67			previous, _, err := safefile.ReadStableRegular(ctx, root, name, before, maxCacheFileBytes)
68			if err != nil {
69				return err
70			}
71			var prior cacheRecord
72			if err := json.Unmarshal(previous, &prior); err != nil {
73				return ErrInvalidData
74			}
75			if err := validateCacheRecord(prior, name); err != nil {
76				return err
77			}
78			merged := MergeReports(append([]Report{report, prior.Report}, prior.Previous...))
79			record.Report, record.Previous = merged[0], merged[1:]
80		}
81		if err := validateCacheRecord(record, name); err != nil {
82			return err
83		}
84		data, err := json.Marshal(record)
85		if err != nil {
86			return err
87		}
88		if len(data) > maxCacheFileBytes {
89			return fmt.Errorf("discovery cache report is too large: %w", ErrInvalidData)
90		}
91		if before == nil {
92			if err := verify(); err != nil {
93				return err
94			}
95			_, err = safefile.CreateNoClobberPrepared(ctx, root, name, data, 0o600, prepareCacheStage)
96		} else {
97			if err := checkCacheFile(filepath.Join(cacheDir, name), before); err != nil {
98				return err
99			}
100			if err := verify(); err != nil {
101				return err
102			}
103			_, err = safefile.AtomicReplacePrepared(ctx, root, name, before, data, 0o600, prepareCacheStage)
104		}
105		if err != nil {
106			return err
107		}
108		return verify()
109	}

111	// ReadCache reads all source reports without creating, refreshing, deleting, or
112	// changing any file. Missing caches return an empty slice. Corrupt/unsafe entries
113	// produce an error alongside any independently valid records; callers must keep
114	// that incomplete observation distinct from an empty successful inventory.
115	func ReadCache(ctx context.Context, cacheDir string, now time.Time) ([]Report, error) {
116		ctx = nonNilContext(ctx)
117		if now.IsZero() {
118			now = time.Now()
119		}
120		reports := []Report{}
121		root, verify, err := openCacheRoot(cacheDir, false)
122		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
123			return reports, nil
124		}
125		if err != nil {
126			return reports, err
127		}
128		defer root.Close()
129		directory, err := root.Open(".")
130		if err != nil {
131			return reports, err
132		}
133		entries, err := directory.ReadDir(maxCacheReports + 1)
134		_ = directory.Close()
135		if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
136			return reports, err
137		}
138		if len(entries) > maxCacheReports {
139			return reports, errors.New("too many discovery cache entries")
140		}
141		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Name() < entries[j].Name() })
142		var failures []error
143		var total int64
144		for _, entry := range entries {
145			if ctx.Err() != nil {
146				return reports, ctx.Err()
147			}
148			name := entry.Name()
149			if !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".json") || !(strings.HasPrefix(name, SourceTailscale+"-") || strings.HasPrefix(name, SourceLAN+"-")) {
150				continue
151			}
152			info, err := root.Lstat(name)
153			if err == nil {
154				err = checkCacheFile(filepath.Join(cacheDir, name), info)
155			}
156			if err != nil {
157				failures = append(failures, fmt.Errorf("read discovery cache entry: %w", err))
158				continue
159			}
160			total += info.Size()
161			if total > maxCacheTotalBytes {
162				failures = append(failures, errors.New("discovery cache exceeds total read bound"))
163				break
164			}
165			data, _, err := safefile.ReadStableRegular(ctx, root, name, info, maxCacheFileBytes)
166			if err != nil {
167				failures = append(failures, fmt.Errorf("read discovery cache entry: %w", err))
168				continue
169			}
170			var record cacheRecord
171			if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &record); err != nil {
172				failures = append(failures, fmt.Errorf("invalid discovery cache version or scope: %w", ErrInvalidData))
173				continue
174			}
175			if err := validateCacheRecord(record, name); err != nil {
176				failures = append(failures, err)
177				continue
178			}
179			for _, report := range append([]Report{record.Report}, record.Previous...) {
180				report.Stale = now.Before(report.ObservedAt) || now.Sub(report.ObservedAt) >= CacheTTL
181				reports = append(reports, report)
182			}
183		}
184		if err := verify(); err != nil {
185			return []Report{}, err
186		}
187		return reports, errors.Join(failures...)
188	}

190	func validateCacheRecord(record cacheRecord, name string) error {
191		if record.Version != cacheVersion || cacheName(record.Report) != name || len(record.Previous) > maxLANEndpoints {
192			return ErrInvalidData
193		}
194		seen := map[string]bool{}
195		total := 0
196		for _, report := range append([]Report{record.Report}, record.Previous...) {
197			if report.Source != record.Report.Source || report.Scope != record.Report.Scope {
198				return ErrInvalidData
199			}
200			if err := validateReport(report); err != nil {
201				return err
202			}
203			for _, candidate := range report.Candidates {
204				if seen[candidate.NativeID] {
205					return ErrInvalidData
206				}
207				seen[candidate.NativeID] = true
208				total++
209				if total > maxLANEndpoints {
210					return ErrInvalidData
211				}
212			}
213		}
214		return nil
215	}

217	func validateReport(report Report) error {

219			return ErrInvalidData

222			return ErrInvalidData
223		}
224		switch report.Status {
225		case StatusReady:
226			if !report.Complete {
227				return ErrInvalidData
228			}
229		case StatusPartial, StatusFailed, StatusUnavailable:
230			if report.Complete {
231				return ErrInvalidData
232			}
233		default:
234			return ErrInvalidData
235		}
236		seen := map[string]bool{}
237		for _, candidate := range report.Candidates {

240				!safeText(candidate.Name, 256) || !safeText(candidate.OS, 64) || candidate.DNSName != "" && !validDNS(candidate.DNSName) || candidate.Port < 1 || candidate.Port > 65535 ||
241				len(candidate.Addresses) == 0 || len(candidate.Addresses) > 32 {
242				return ErrInvalidData
243			}
244			seen[candidate.ID] = true
245			if candidate.State != StateDiscovered && candidate.State != StateSSH && candidate.State != StateOpen {
246				return ErrInvalidData
247			}
248			for _, raw := range candidate.Addresses {
249				address, err := netip.ParseAddr(raw)
250				if err != nil || address.Zone() != "" || address.IsUnspecified() || address.IsLoopback() || address.IsMulticast() {
251					return ErrInvalidData
252				}
253			}
254		}
255		return nil
256	}

258	// The root walk rejects every symlink component, while held os.Root handles
259	// prevent a changed path from redirecting reads or writes outside the walked
260	// tree. verify rechecks every named component before and after publication.
261	func openCacheRoot(path string, create bool) (*os.Root, func() error, error) {
262		if err := cachePlatformSupported(); err != nil {
263			return nil, nil, err
264		}
265		if !filepath.IsAbs(path) || filepath.Clean(path) != path || path == string(filepath.Separator) {
266			return nil, nil, ErrUnsafeCache
267		}
268		anchor, err := platformfs.Resolve(path)
269		if err != nil {
270			return nil, nil, err
271		}
272		base := anchor.Path
273		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(base)
274		if err != nil {
275			return nil, nil, err
276		}
277		if err := checkCacheAncestor(base, rootInfo); err != nil {
278			root.Close()
279			return nil, nil, err
280		}
281		type heldDirectory struct {
282			path string
283			info fs.FileInfo
284		}
285		held := []heldDirectory{{path: base, info: rootInfo}}
286		components := strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(path, base), string(filepath.Separator)), string(filepath.Separator))
287		currentPath := base
288		for index, component := range components {
289			if component == "" || component == "." || component == ".." {
290				root.Close()
291				return nil, nil, ErrUnsafeCache
292			}
293			currentPath = filepath.Join(currentPath, component)
294			info, err := root.Lstat(component)
295			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) && create {
296				err = root.Mkdir(component, 0o700)
297				if err == nil {
298					err = setCachePrivate(currentPath, 0o700)
299				}
300				if err == nil || errors.Is(err, fs.ErrExist) {
301					info, err = root.Lstat(component)
302				}
303			}
304			if err != nil {
305				root.Close()
306				return nil, nil, err
307			}
308			if index == len(components)-1 {
309				err = checkCacheDirectory(currentPath, info)
310			} else {
311				err = checkCacheAncestor(currentPath, info)
312			}
313			if err != nil {
314				root.Close()
315				return nil, nil, err
316			}
317			child, childInfo, err := safefile.OpenChildRoot(root, component)
318			root.Close()
319			if err != nil {
320				return nil, nil, err
321			}
322			root = child
323			held = append(held, heldDirectory{path: currentPath, info: childInfo})
324		}
325		verify := func() error {
326			if err := anchor.Verify(); err != nil {
327				return err
328			}
329			for index, directory := range held {
330				if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(directory.path, directory.info); err != nil {
331					return err
332				}
333				info, err := os.Lstat(directory.path)
334				if err != nil {
335					return err
336				}
337				if index == len(held)-1 {
338					err = checkCacheDirectory(directory.path, info)
339				} else {
340					err = checkCacheAncestor(directory.path, info)
341				}
342				if err != nil {
343					return err
344				}
345			}
346			return nil
347		}
348		if err := verify(); err != nil {
349			root.Close()
350			return nil, nil, err
351		}
352		return root, verify, nil
353	}

356		return setCachePrivate(file.Name(), 0o600)
357	}
```

```text
2	// observations only: neither an advertised service nor an SSH banner proves
3	// authentication, and neither creates an OpenSSH alias or fleet registration.
4	package sshdiscovery
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"errors"
9		"net"
10		"time"
11	
12		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/sshhost"
13	)
14	
15	const (
16		SourceTailscale   = "tailscale"
17		SourceLAN         = "lan"
18		StatusReady       = "ready"
19		StatusPartial     = "partial"
20		StatusUnavailable = "unavailable"
21		StatusFailed      = "failed"
22	
23		StateDiscovered = "discovered"
24		StateSSH        = "ssh_banner"
25		StateOpen       = "open_unknown"
26	
27		CacheTTL = 5 * time.Minute
28	)
29	
30	var (
31		ErrUnavailable  = errors.New("discovery dependency unavailable")
32		ErrInvalidData  = errors.New("invalid discovery data")
33		ErrInvalidScope = errors.New("invalid or unavailable on-link discovery scope")
34		ErrNotFound     = errors.New("discovery candidate not found")
35		ErrAmbiguous    = errors.New("discovery candidate selection is ambiguous")
36		ErrUnsafeCache  = errors.New("unsafe discovery cache")
37	)
38	
39	// Candidate contains only connection suggestions and source observations.
40	// Online means control-plane presence for Tailscale, not successful SSH login.
41	// AdvertisesSSH is advisory; false never proves that Tailscale SSH is disabled.
42	type Candidate struct {
43		ID            string     `json:"id"`
44		Source        string     `json:"source"`
45		Scope         string     `json:"scope"`
46		NativeID      string     `json:"native_id,omitempty"`
47		Name          string     `json:"name,omitempty"`
48		DNSName       string     `json:"dns_name,omitempty"`
49		Addresses     []string   `json:"addresses"`
50		Port          int        `json:"port"`
51		OS            string     `json:"os,omitempty"`
52		Online        *bool      `json:"online,omitempty"`
53		AdvertisesSSH bool       `json:"advertises_ssh"`
54		LastSeen      *time.Time `json:"last_seen,omitempty"`
55		State         string     `json:"state"`
56	}
57	
58	// Report describes one explicit discovery attempt, including incomplete ones.
59	// Cached reports retain their observation time and are never authentication
60	// authority, including during the five-minute freshness window.
61	type Report struct {
62		Source     string      `json:"source"`
63		Status     string      `json:"status"`
64		Complete   bool        `json:"complete"`
65		ObservedAt time.Time   `json:"observed_at"`
66		Stale      bool        `json:"stale"`
67		Scope      string      `json:"scope"`
68		Candidates []Candidate `json:"candidates"`
69	}
70	
71	// Progress describes completed probes in one explicit LAN scan. Callbacks run
72	// serially; Candidate is a detached observation and may be retained by the UI.
73	type Progress struct {
74		Completed int
75		Total     int
76		Candidate *Candidate
77	}
78	
79	// InterfaceScope is an eligible, active, directly connected IPv4 network.
80	// Prefix may contain more than 256 addresses; callers must select an explicit
81	// bounded subset for LAN, rather than implicitly scanning the whole prefix.
82	type InterfaceScope struct {
83		Interface string `json:"interface"`
84		Index     int    `json:"index"`
85		Address   string `json:"address"`
86		Prefix    string `json:"prefix"`
87	}
88	
89	// LANRequest always requires explicit IPv4 addresses or CIDR ranges. Interface
90	// may be omitted only when exactly one eligible interface contains every range.
91	type LANRequest struct {
92		Interface string   `json:"interface,omitempty"`
93		Ranges    []string `json:"ranges"`
94		Ports     []int    `json:"ports,omitempty"`
95	}
96	
97	// ServiceOptions supplies deterministic, network-free seams for callers and
98	// tests. The production bounds cannot be increased through these options.
99	type ServiceOptions struct {
100		DialContext func(context.Context, string, string) (net.Conn, error)
101		LookupAddr  func(context.Context, string) ([]string, error)
102		Interfaces  func() ([]InterfaceScope, error)
103		Now         func() time.Time
104	}
105	
106	type Service struct {
107		runner  sshhost.Runner
108		options ServiceOptions
109	}
110	
111	// NewService uses the optional CLI only on Tailscale, and the network only on
112	// LAN. Constructing a service performs no I/O. Later options override earlier
113	// non-nil hooks.
114	func NewService(runner sshhost.Runner, options ...ServiceOptions) *Service {
115		if runner == nil {
116			runner = sshhost.ExecRunner{}
117		}
118		s := &Service{runner: runner, options: ServiceOptions{
119			DialContext: (&net.Dialer{}).DialContext,
120			LookupAddr:  net.DefaultResolver.LookupAddr,
121			Interfaces:  listInterfaces,
122			Now:         time.Now,
123		}}
124		for _, option := range options {
125			if option.DialContext != nil {
126				s.options.DialContext = option.DialContext
127			}
128			if option.LookupAddr != nil {
129				s.options.LookupAddr = option.LookupAddr
130			}
131			if option.Interfaces != nil {
132				s.options.Interfaces = option.Interfaces
133			}
134			if option.Now != nil {
135				s.options.Now = option.Now
136			}
137		}
138		return s
139	}
140	
141	func (s *Service) report(source, scope string) Report {
142		return Report{Source: source, Scope: scope, Status: StatusFailed,
143			ObservedAt: s.options.Now().UTC(), Candidates: []Candidate{}}
144	}
145	
146	func nonNilContext(ctx context.Context) context.Context {
147		if ctx == nil {
148			return context.Background()
149		}
150		return ctx
151	}
152
```

```text
29	func listInterfaces() ([]InterfaceScope, error) {
30		interfaces, err := net.Interfaces()
31		if err != nil {
32			return nil, err
33		}
34		var scopes []InterfaceScope
35		for _, iface := range interfaces {
36			if iface.Flags&net.FlagUp == 0 || iface.Flags&net.FlagLoopback != 0 || iface.Flags&net.FlagPointToPoint != 0 || iface.Flags&net.FlagBroadcast == 0 {
37				continue
38			}
39			addresses, err := iface.Addrs()
40			if err != nil {
41				return nil, fmt.Errorf("read interface addresses: %w", err)
42			}
43			for _, address := range addresses {
44				prefix, err := netip.ParsePrefix(address.String())
45				if err != nil || !usableIPv4(prefix.Addr()) {
46					continue
47				}
48				scopes = append(scopes, InterfaceScope{Interface: iface.Name, Index: iface.Index,
49					Address: prefix.Addr().String(), Prefix: prefix.Masked().String()})
50			}
51		}
52		return scopes, nil
53	}

55	// Interfaces reads local interface metadata; it sends no network packets.

60		}

73			if result[i].Interface != result[j].Interface {
74				return result[i].Interface < result[j].Interface
75			}
76			if result[i].Prefix != result[j].Prefix {
77				return result[i].Prefix < result[j].Prefix
78			}
79			return result[i].Address < result[j].Address

84	type lanPlan struct {

90	// LANScope validates and normalizes an explicit scan scope against current
91	// interfaces, without probing endpoints. It is also the exact cache scope key.
92	func (s *Service) LANScope(request LANRequest) (string, error) {
93		plan, err := s.prepareLAN(request)
94		return plan.scope, err
95	}
96	
97	// CurrentLANScope checks whether a recorded scope still describes the same
98	// current interface, address set and explicitly selected ranges/ports. It reads
99	// local interface metadata only and does not probe or authenticate any endpoint.
100	func (s *Service) CurrentLANScope(scope string) (bool, error) {
101		parts := strings.Split(scope, ";")
102		if len(parts) != 4 || !strings.HasPrefix(parts[0], "interface=") || !strings.HasPrefix(parts[1], "onlink=") ||
103			!strings.HasPrefix(parts[2], "ranges=") || !strings.HasPrefix(parts[3], "ports=") {
104			return false, ErrInvalidScope
105		}
106		iface, index, ok := strings.Cut(strings.TrimPrefix(parts[0], "interface="), "#")
107		if !ok || iface == "" || index == "" {
108			return false, ErrInvalidScope
109		}
110		request := LANRequest{Interface: iface, Ranges: strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(parts[2], "ranges="), ",")}
111		for _, text := range strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(parts[3], "ports="), ",") {
112			port, err := strconv.Atoi(text)
113			if err != nil {
114				return false, ErrInvalidScope
115			}
116			request.Ports = append(request.Ports, port)
117		}
118		current, err := s.LANScope(request)
119		if err != nil {
120			return false, err
121		}
122		return current == scope, nil
123	}
124	
125	func (s *Service) prepareLAN(request LANRequest) (lanPlan, error) {
126		if len(request.Ranges) == 0 || len(request.Ranges) > maxLANAddresses {
127			return lanPlan{}, fmt.Errorf("select explicit IPv4 ranges totaling at most %d addresses: %w", maxLANAddresses, ErrInvalidScope)
128		}
129		ports := append([]int(nil), request.Ports...)
130		if len(ports) == 0 {
131			ports = []int{22}
132		}
133		if len(ports) > maxLANPorts {
134			return lanPlan{}, fmt.Errorf("at most %d ports are allowed: %w", maxLANPorts, ErrInvalidScope)
135		}
136		sort.Ints(ports)
137		uniquePorts := ports[:0]
138		for _, port := range ports {
139			if port < 1 || port > 65535 {
140				return lanPlan{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid TCP port: %w", ErrInvalidScope)
141			}
142			if len(uniquePorts) == 0 || uniquePorts[len(uniquePorts)-1] != port {
143				uniquePorts = append(uniquePorts, port)
144			}
145		}
146		ports = uniquePorts
147		addresses := map[netip.Addr]bool{}
148		ranges := map[string]bool{}
149		for _, raw := range request.Ranges {
150			prefix, err := netip.ParsePrefix(raw)
151			if err != nil {
152				address, addrErr := netip.ParseAddr(raw)
153				if addrErr != nil || !address.Is4() {
154					return lanPlan{}, fmt.Errorf("LAN ranges must be literal IPv4 addresses or CIDRs: %w", ErrInvalidScope)
155				}
156				prefix = netip.PrefixFrom(address, 32)
157			}
158			if !prefix.Addr().Is4() || prefix.Bits() < 24 {
159				return lanPlan{}, fmt.Errorf("each LAN range must contain at most %d addresses: %w", maxLANAddresses, ErrInvalidScope)
160			}
161			prefix = prefix.Masked()
162			ranges[prefix.String()] = true
163			for address := prefix.Addr(); address.IsValid() && prefix.Contains(address); address = address.Next() {
164				if !usableIPv4(address) {
165					return lanPlan{}, fmt.Errorf("range includes non-unicast IPv4 addresses: %w", ErrInvalidScope)
166				}
167				addresses[address] = true
168				if len(addresses) > maxLANAddresses {
169					return lanPlan{}, fmt.Errorf("LAN ranges exceed %d addresses: %w", maxLANAddresses, ErrInvalidScope)
170				}
171			}
172		}
173		if len(addresses)*len(ports) > maxLANEndpoints {
174			return lanPlan{}, fmt.Errorf("LAN scope exceeds %d endpoints: %w", maxLANEndpoints, ErrInvalidScope)
175		}
176		scopes, err := s.Interfaces()
177		if err != nil {
178			return lanPlan{}, err
179		}
180		byInterface := map[string][]InterfaceScope{}
181		for _, scope := range scopes {
182			if request.Interface == "" || scope.Interface == request.Interface {
183				key := scope.Interface + "#" + strconv.Itoa(scope.Index)
184				byInterface[key] = append(byInterface[key], scope)
185			}
186		}
187		var matching []string
188		for key, group := range byInterface {
189			containsAll := true
190			for address := range addresses {
191				contained := false
192				for _, scope := range group {
193					prefix, _ := netip.ParsePrefix(scope.Prefix)
194					contained = contained || prefix.Contains(address)
195				}
196				containsAll = containsAll && contained
197			}
198			if containsAll {
199				matching = append(matching, key)
200			}
201		}
202		if len(matching) != 1 {
203			return lanPlan{}, fmt.Errorf("ranges must belong to exactly one selected active broadcast interface: %w", ErrInvalidScope)
204		}
205		group := byInterface[matching[0]]
206		self := map[netip.Addr]bool{}
207		// Exclude every local address, including another interface on the same link.
208		for _, scope := range scopes {
209			address, _ := netip.ParseAddr(scope.Address)
210			self[address] = true
211		}
212		var targets []netip.Addr
213		for address := range addresses {
214			if self[address] {
215				continue
216			}
217			reserved := false
218			for _, scope := range group {
219				prefix, _ := netip.ParsePrefix(scope.Prefix)
220				if prefix.Contains(address) && prefix.Bits() <= 30 {
221					reserved = reserved || address == prefix.Addr() || address == lastIPv4(prefix)
222				}
223			}
224			if !reserved {
225				targets = append(targets, address)
226			}
227		}
228		if len(targets) == 0 {
229			return lanPlan{}, fmt.Errorf("scope contains no remote unicast addresses: %w", ErrInvalidScope)
230		}
231		sort.Slice(targets, func(i, j int) bool { return targets[i].Less(targets[j]) })
232		var rangeNames, interfaceNames, portNames []string
233		for value := range ranges {
234			rangeNames = append(rangeNames, value)
235		}
236		for _, scope := range group {
237			interfaceNames = append(interfaceNames, scope.Address+"/"+scope.Prefix)
238		}
239		for _, port := range ports {
240			portNames = append(portNames, strconv.Itoa(port))
241		}
242		sort.Strings(rangeNames)
243		sort.Strings(interfaceNames)
244		scope := "interface=" + matching[0] + ";onlink=" + strings.Join(interfaceNames, ",") + ";ranges=" + strings.Join(rangeNames, ",") + ";ports=" + strings.Join(portNames, ",")
245		return lanPlan{scope: scope, addresses: targets, ports: ports}, nil
246	}

248	func usableIPv4(address netip.Addr) bool {
249		return address.Is4() && !address.IsUnspecified() && !address.IsLoopback() && !address.IsMulticast() && address != netip.MustParseAddr("255.255.255.255")
250	}
251	
252	func lastIPv4(prefix netip.Prefix) netip.Addr {
253		bytes := prefix.Masked().Addr().As4()
254		bits := uint32(bytes[0])<<24 | uint32(bytes[1])<<16 | uint32(bytes[2])<<8 | uint32(bytes[3])
255		bits |= uint32(0xffffffff) >> uint(prefix.Bits())
256		return netip.AddrFrom4([4]byte{byte(bits >> 24), byte(bits >> 16), byte(bits >> 8), byte(bits)})
257	}

259	type lanEndpoint struct {

261		port    int
262	}
263	type lanResult struct{ candidate *Candidate }
264	type ptrResult struct {
```
